column3: MT 49:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “sons of Adam and sons of man” is rendered “low and high.”
Close to the Hebrew; חִידָתִי (“my riddle”) is rendered “my dark saying.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the iniquity of my heels” is rendered “the iniquity at my heels.”
Close to the Hebrew; קִרְבָּם (“their inward part”) is rendered “Their inner thought is.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV renders “and after them they delight in their mouth” as “their posterity who approve their sayings.”
The verse is difficult; NKJV renders לִשְׁאוֹל (“for Sheol”) as “in the grave,” “death will shepherd them” as “Death shall feed on them,” and supplies “far from their dwelling.”
Close to the Hebrew; שְׁאוֹל (“Sheol”) is rendered “the grave,” and “hand” “power.”
